---
title: "Install"
---

Python 3.10 or newer.

```bash
pip install git+https://github.com/HI-IDN/kyngreinir.git
```

That gives you the `kyngreinir` command and the `kyngreinir` Python package:

```bash
kyngreinir --help
```

A snapshot of the register ships with the package, so there is nothing to download before
the first classification, and no network access afterwards.

## From source

```bash
git clone git@github.com:HI-IDN/kyngreinir.git
cd kyngreinir
pip install -e ".[dev]"
pytest
```

## As a dependency

In a `pyproject.toml`:

```toml
dependencies = [
    "kyngreinir @ git+https://github.com/HI-IDN/kyngreinir.git",
]
```
